Name: (CP) Truffle Foxes - Pig Replacement or New Animal
Author: iwilleatyourdog
Description:
[color=#b4a7d6][size=5][center]Hello There ^^[/center][/size][/color]
[size=4]
[color=#d5a6bd]Few words about mod[/color][/size]

As written above these truffle foxes can be replacment for pigs or fully new separate animals. Foxes come in 4 colours: Candy (pink), Hazel (brown), Snow (white) and Void (black). The mod includes custom fox sound.


[color=#d5a6bd][size=4]Config

[/size][/color]I recommend using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] because there are 3 config options: "Foxes are", "Default Fox" and "sound". "Foxes are" is the option where you decide if foxes are replacment for pigs or new separate animal. Default is replacement. Option "Default Fox" has no use when foxes are separate animals but when they are replacement, pigs you already had before becomes the default fox. "Sound" is just Custom fox sound or vanilla pig sound.
Warning: changes may not get aplied until you lauch the game again.


[color=#d5a6bd][size=4]Little recomendations[/size][/color]

Again, I recommend using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], it really makes thing easier. Also, if you are going to have your foxes as pig remlacement i recommend using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39199]Animal Skin Preview[/url] so that you know which skin of fox you're buying.
